explanation: A dense dial over prose that reports how many, which rank, or where to: it peaks (0.45-1.0 of max) on a count numeral or ordinal for a counted noun after a possession, containment or result verb ('He has three brothers', 'owns forty paintings', 'won three awards', 'No. 3', 'one of five churches', 'third place'; not after 'my', as in 'I love my two dogs'), gives a fixed ~0.45 on the first '.' or line break of any text whatever its content ('!' and '?' stay near 0.1), and gives 0.3-0.66 on a path or landmark preposition after a motion or position verb ('marched toward', 'walked from ... to', 'flew into', 'stands above', 'lay on', 'over the hills'), on a copula that is the text's second token ('It was', 'He was', 'I am', 'Bob is'), and on most third-person narration of actions, imperatives and non-English prose. Text with no '.', line break, counted numeral, path preposition or second-token copula that describes qualities, tastes, feelings or opinions stays below 0.25 at any length, in first or third person ('The hotel is elegant and charming with a calm atmosphere', 'The novel is funny and sad and very well written', 'I think this plan is great', 'He felt sad and tired'), as do 'in/on/at' locations without motion ('The book is on the table', 'The children played in the garden'), short code assignments and import lines.
